  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene

    const viewport = document.getElementById("viewport");
    const loading = document.getElementById("loading");

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();

    );

    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.08;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    viewport.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xccebf2, 0x31554d, 2.1);
    scene.add(hemi);

    const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff1cf, 3.4);
    sun.position.set(-18, 28, 14);
    sun.castShadow = true;
    sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    sun.shadow.camera.left = -22;
    sun.shadow.camera.right = 22;
    sun.shadow.camera.top = 22;
    sun.shadow.camera.bottom = -22;
    sun.shadow.camera.near = 1;
    sun.shadow.camera.far = 75;
    sun.shadow.bias = -0.00035;
    scene.add(sun);

    const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x8bd7e8, 0.8);
    fill.position.set(15, 10, -20);
    scene.add(fill);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Materials and geometry helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const materials = {
      hullDark: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x263c45,
        roughness: 0.62,
        metalness: 0.18,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide
      }),
      hull: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x123441,
        roughness: 0.48,
        metalness: 0.28,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide
      }),
      orange: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xe76c32,
        roughness: 0.5,
        metalness: 0.12
      }),
      white: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xe8efeb,
        roughness: 0.58,
        metalness: 0.08
      }),
      cabin: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xf1f3e9,
        roughness: 0.62,
        metalness: 0.06
      }),
      glass: new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
        color: 0x183c49,
        roughness: 0.12,
        metalness: 0.15,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.8,
        emissive: 0x0b2730,
        emissiveIntensity: 0.45
      }),
      metal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xaebbc0,
        roughness: 0.32,
        metalness: 0.78
      }),
      darkMetal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x263238,
        roughness: 0.48,
        metalness: 0.65
      }),
      yellow: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xe5ad28,
        roughness: 0.43,
        metalness: 0.25
      }),
      black: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x11191d,
        roughness: 0.78,
        metalness: 0.08
      }),
      red: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xc83d35,
        roughness: 0.58,
        metalness: 0.08
      }),
      crate: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x8a6747,
        roughness: 0.88
      }),
      rope: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xb9a47b,
        roughness: 1
      })
    };

    function addBox(w, h, d, material, x, y, z, parent = scene) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d), material);
      mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addCylinder(
      radiusTop,
      radiusBottom,
      height,
      material,
      x,
      y,
      z,
      parent = scene,
      segments = 16
    ) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radiusTop, radiusBottom, height, segments),
        material
      );
      mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addRod(a, b, radius, material, parent = scene, segments = 10) {
      const start = new THREE.Vector3(...a);
      const end = new THREE.Vector3(...b);
      const direction = end.clone().sub(start);
      const length = direction.length();

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius, radius, length, segments),
        material
      );

      mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        direction.normalize()
      );
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addSphere(radius, material, x, y, z, parent = scene) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(radius, 18, 12),
        material
      );
      mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addWindow(x, y, z, w = 1.1, h = 0.65, ry = 0) {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      group.position.set(x, y, z);
      group.rotation.y = ry;

      addBox(w + 0.12, h + 0.12, 0.1, materials.darkMetal, 0, 0, 0, group);
      addBox(w, h, 0.12, materials.glass, 0, 0, 0.07, group);

      const mullion = addBox(
        0.055,
        h,
        0.14,
        materials.darkMetal,
        0,
        0,
        0.13,
        group
      );
      mullion.castShadow = false;

      scene.add(group);
      return group;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Water
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const waterGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(140, 140, 100, 100);
    waterGeometry.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);

    const waterBase = Float32Array.from(waterGeometry.attributes.position.array);
    const waterMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: 0x287f8b,
      roughness: 0.28,
      metalness: 0.3,
      clearcoat: 0.72,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.25,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.96
    });

    const water = new THREE.Mesh(waterGeometry, waterMaterial);
    water.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(water);

    // Soft wake planes.
    const wakeMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0xd9f3ed,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.16,
      depthWrite: false
    });

    const wakeLeft = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(4.7, 17),
      wakeMaterial
    );
    wakeLeft.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    wakeLeft.position.set(-3.1, 0.29, 0.2);
    wakeLeft.scale.y = 1.35;
    scene.add(wakeLeft);

    const wakeRight = wakeLeft.clone();
    wakeRight.position.x = 3.1;
    scene.add(wakeRight);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Hull
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const stations = [
      { z: -7.0, width: 0.18, keel: -0.38 },
      { z: -6.6, width: 1.75, keel: -0.65 },
      { z: -5.0, width: 2.25, keel: -0.85 },
      { z: 4.8, width: 2.35, keel: -0.85 },
      { z: 6.0, width: 1.9, keel: -0.65 },
      { z: 7.0, width: 0.18, keel: -0.38 }
    ];

    function createHullGeometry() {
      const positions = [];
      const indices = [];
      const groups = [];

      for (const station of stations) {
        const w = station.width;
        const k = station.keel;
        const c = 0.47;
        positions.push(
          0, k, station.z,
          w * 0.78, c, station.z,
          w, 0.82, station.z,
          -w * 0.78, c, station.z
        );
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < stations.length - 1; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
          const a = i * 4 + j;
          const b = i * 4 + (j + 1) % 4;
          const c = (i + 1) * 4 + j;
          const d = (i + 1) * 4 + (j + 1) % 4;

          indices.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);

          const materialIndex = j === 0 ? 0 : 1;
          groups.push({
            start: indices.length,
            count: 6,
            materialIndex
          });
        }
      }

      // Bow and stern caps.
      indices.push(0, 2, 1, 0, 3, 2);
      indices.push(
        (stations.length - 1) * 4,
        (stations.length - 1) * 4 + 2,
        (stations.length - 1) * 4 + 1,
        (stations.length - 1) * 4,
        (stations.length - 1) * 4 + 3,
        (stations.length - 1) * 4 + 2
      );

      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setAttribute(
        "position",
        new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3)
      );
      geometry.setIndex(indices);
      geometry.addGroups(groups);
      geometry.computeVertexNormals();
      return geometry;
    }

    const hull = new THREE.Mesh(
      createHullGeometry(),
      [materials.hullDark, materials.hull]
    );
    hull.castShadow = true;
    hull.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(hull);

    // Orange rubbing strakes.
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const points = stations.map((s) =>
        new THREE.Vector3(side * s.width, 0.47, s.z)
      );
      const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points);
      const strake = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 64, 0.055, 6, false),
        materials.orange
      );
      strake.castShadow = true;
      scene.add(strake);
    }

    // Non-skid working-deck texture.
    const deckCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    deckCanvas.width = deckCanvas.height = 512;
    const deckContext = deckCanvas.getContext("2d");
    deckContext.fillStyle = "#68777b";
    deckContext.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);

    for (let i = 0; i < 8500; i++) {
      const v = Math.floor(75 + Math.random() * 65);
      deckContext.fillStyle = `rgba(${v},${v + 8},${v + 10},0.25)`;
      deckContext.fillRect(
        Math.random() * 512,
        Math.random() * 512,
        1 + Math.random() * 2,
        1 + Math.random() * 2
      );
    }

    deckContext.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.12)";
    deckContext.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let p = 0; p <= 512; p += 64) {
      deckContext.beginPath();
      deckContext.moveTo(p, 0);
      deckContext.lineTo(p, 512);
      deckContext.stroke();
      deckContext.beginPath();
      deckContext.moveTo(0, p);
      deckContext.lineTo(512, p);
      deckContext.stroke();
    }

    const deckTexture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(deckCanvas);
    deckTexture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    deckTexture.wrapS = deckTexture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    deckTexture.repeat.set(4, 10);
    deckTexture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();

    const deckMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x899497,
      map: deckTexture,
      roughness: 0.86,
      metalness: 0.12
    });

    addBox(4.45, 0.2, 12.6, deckMaterial, 0, 0.82, 0.15);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Deckhouse
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    addBox(4.15, 2.15, 4.25, materials.cabin, 0, 1.95, 3.0);
    addBox(4.38, 0.22, 4.48, materials.darkMetal, 0, 0.95, 3.0);
    addBox(4.4, 0.16, 4.5, materials.white, 0, 3.08, 3.0);

    addWindow(0, 2.55, 5.14, 2.6, 0.72);
    addWindow(0, 2.55, 0.86, 1.05, 0.7);

    addWindow(-2.09, 2.55, 3.0, 0.72, 0.72, Math.PI / 2);
    addWindow(2.09, 2.55, 3.0, 0.72, 0.72, -Math.PI / 2);

    addBox(0.85, 1.75, 0.08, materials.white, 1.25, 1.72, 0.91);
    addBox(0.64, 1.5, 0.09, materials.glass, 1.25, 1.75, 0.97);
    addBox(0.08, 0.28, 0.1, materials.metal, 1.25, 1.75, 1.03);

    // Roof equipment.
    addCylinder(0.12, 0.16, 0.85, materials.darkMetal, -1.25, 3.5, 3.0);
    addCylinder(0.23, 0.23, 0.12, materials.black, -1.25, 3.96, 3.0);

    // Mast, stays, radar, and navigation equipment.
    addRod([0, 3.15, -0.25], [0, 5.55, -0.25], 0.055, materials.metal);
    addRod([-1.0, 4.55, -0.25], [1.0, 4.55, -0.25], 0.045, materials.metal);
    addRod([0, 4.8, -0.25], [0, 5.6, -0.25], 0.025, materials.metal);

    const radar = new THREE.Group();
    radar.position.set(0, 4.02, 2.65);
    addBox(0.1, 0.1, 1.0, materials.white, 0, 0, 0, radar);
    addBox(2.4, 0.12, 0.34, materials.white, 0, 0, 0, radar);
    addCylinder(0.08, 0.08, 0.35, materials.darkMetal, 0, -0.2, 0, radar);
    scene.add(radar);

    // Mast navigation lights.
    const navGreen = addSphere(0.12, materials.red, -2.25, 2.18, 5.18);
    const navRed = addSphere(0.12, materials.red, 2.25, 2.18, 5.18);
    const mastLight = addSphere(0.13, materials.white, 0, 5.63, -0.25);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Stern crane
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    addBox(1.8, 0.18, 1.45, materials.darkMetal, 0, 1.0, -5.62);
    addBox(0.62, 1.65, 0.62, materials.yellow, 0, 1.85, -5.62);
    addBox(0.78, 0.18, 0.78, materials.yellow, 0, 2.7, -5.62);

    const boomPivot = new THREE.Group();
    boomPivot.position.set(0, 2.72, -5.62);
    scene.add(boomPivot);

    addRod([0, 0, 0], [0, 1.8, 3.7], 0.13, materials.yellow, boomPivot);
    addRod([0, 0, 0], [0, -0.85, -1.85], 0.13, materials.yellow, boomPivot);
    addBox(0.58, 0.8, 0.65, materials.yellow, 0.75, 2.05, -5.35);
    addWindow(0.77, 2.35, -5.0, 0.48, 0.38);
    addBox(0.12, 0.45, 0.12, materials.darkMetal, 0.3, 2.3, -4.98);

    addRod(
      [0.28, 0.05, -0.15],
      [0.2, 1.0, 2.6],
      0.075,
      materials.metal,
      boomPivot
    );
    addRod(
      [0.2, 1.0, 2.6],
      [0.18, 1.75, 3.45],
      0.05,
      materials.darkMetal,
      boomPivot
    );

    addBox(0.55, 0.38, 0.42, materials.darkMetal, 0, -0.95, -1.85, boomPivot);

    const tipLocal = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.8, 3.7);
    const hook = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(hook);

    const cable = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.025, 0.025, 1, 8),
      materials.darkMetal
    );
    cable.castShadow = true;
    scene.add(cable);

    const hookRing = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.22, 0.065, 8, 18, Math.PI * 1.55),
      materials.darkMetal
    );
    hookRing.rotation.z = Math.PI * 0.25;
    hookRing.castShadow = true;
    hook.add(hookRing);

    const buoy = new THREE.Group();
    buoy.position.y = -0.28;
    hook.add(buoy);

    addCylinder(0.28, 0.21, 0.48, materials.red, 0, 0, 0, buoy);
    addCylinder(0.3, 0.3, 0.12, materials.white, 0, 0.08, 0, buoy);
    addCylinder(0, 0.27, 0.22, materials.white, 0, 0.38, 0, buoy);
    addSphere(0.12, materials.orange, 0, 0.55, 0, buoy);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Aft working deck
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    // Deck hatches.
    for (const x of [-1.35, 1.35]) {
      addBox(1.45, 0.12, 1.25, materials.darkMetal, x, 0.95, -3.55);
      addBox(1.28, 0.08, 1.08, deckMaterial, x, 1.03, -3.55);
      addBox(0.35, 0.08, 0.08, materials.metal, x, 1.1, -3.0);
    }

    // Toolbox and crates.
    addBox(1.25, 0.62, 0.75, materials.crate, 1.45, 1.32, -2.7);
    addBox(1.05, 0.45, 0.65, materials.crate, -1.7, 1.14, -2.85);
    addBox(0.78, 0.32, 0.52, materials.darkMetal, -1.65, 1.45, -2.85);

    // Winch.
    addBox(1.55, 0.18, 1.2, materials.darkMetal, -1.45, 1.02, -1.45);
    const winchDrum = addCylinder(
      0.31,
      0.31,
      1.18,
      materials.metal,
      -1.45,
      1.3,
      -1.45
    );
    winchDrum.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;

    for (const x of [-2.03, -0.87]) {
      const flange = addCylinder(
